description: Before ~July 2016 weekly crude exports were estimates based on monthly Census data; afterwards EIA uses near-real-time weekly Census export data
EIA revised weekly production estimation methodology; weekly production rounded/modeled from STEO short-term model
EIA introduced 'transfers to crude oil supply' line in WPSR Table 1 to reduce the persistent positive crude adjustment (unaccounted-for crude)
Cushing OK stocks series begins; constrains earliest common sample
Large sustained SPR drawdowns (policy releases) 2022-2023 make SPR flow non-negligible in total balance
